purpose: Track candidate-gene / GWAS denominator-expansion lane opened in rev0018.
thesis: The lane is not “candidate genes were silly.” It is: plausible, low-dimensional hypotheses need denominator-scale calibration when the true architecture is high-dimensional, small-effect, phenotype-sensitive, and socially high-stakes.
rails: GWAS Catalog as genome-wide association and summary-statistics rail
PGC as psychiatric genomics consortium-scale analysis/data rail
guardrails: Not a claim that GWAS equals causation.
Positive-control candidate-gene successes are required before any broad synthesis.
next_controls: split/merge memo after second-pass source review
rev0019_thesis: After denominator-pressure records, the lane now adds positive controls so candidate-gene failure is not mistaken for anti-genetics. Robust genetic knowledge tends to require tighter phenotype, mechanism/effect-size, population-scope, or actionability conditions, but this remains candidate-level.
